hypothesis.statement: UE 5.6 installation cannot safely begin with less than the project headroom, but broad cache or Docker deletion could interrupt Voicebox generation or destroy active development databases.
hypothesis.action: Measure physical disk, regenerable host caches, Docker reclaim categories and active processes read-only; protect all volumes, running containers and Voicebox generation.
hypothesis.expectedResult: A bounded cleanup choice can reach installation headroom without treating active or stateful data as disposable.

importantCaveat: Docker.raw is a sparse VM disk; logical prune estimates do not guarantee immediate host free-space recovery until Docker compacts/reclaims the image.
decision: Cache-only cleanup is insufficient. The least destructive candidate is selected regenerable host caches plus Docker build cache and unused images, explicitly excluding volumes and active containers; it still requires user approval and a post-cleanup df/preflight checkpoint.
nextGate: After approved cleanup, require at least 80 GiB actual free space and rerun metahuman-toolchain preflight before starting UE installation.
